explanation: Nonzero only at GO steps where the agent chooses a1; it is always 0 at D1 and D2 and whenever a2 is chosen. If the previous trial was a rewarded a1 to S1 common trial, it is 8-10 (6-8 right after an unrewarded trial, 10 deep in a long rewarded a1 streak). If the previous trial was unrewarded after a common transition, it falls to about 2-3, and it is about 0 when the previous trial was a rare transition, or when there were two misses in a row.
